visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand, showing detailed skin texture and natural fingernails, firmly holds a small square device composed of four mechanical keyboard keycaps. One white keycap has the text "沒出息", and another says "我憋不越你!!", while two others feature cartoonish portraits of a man in a black suit. The background is an indoor residential setting with a blurred gray floor and a yellow basketball. (2) The hand's thumb presses down on one of the keycaps, causing it to emit a bright, vibrant yellow light that illuminates the surrounding plastic housing. The camera shifts slightly to show the side of the yellow cube, which has a sticker featuring a photo of a man in a suit with musical notes and the text "議員: 王世堅". The lighting is direct and bright indoor lighting. (3) The scene transitions to a larger yellow plastic toy featuring a 3D figurine of the same man, wearing a striped suit and red tie with his hands raised in an expressive, celebratory gesture. The device has large red text "沒出息" and smaller black characters below it. A metal keychain ring is attached to the side, and a speaker grill is visible on the bottom part of the yellow casing. (4) Both toys are showcased together on a dark wooden surface, with the hand continuing to manipulate the larger figurine toy to trigger internal lights and sounds. In the background, a green toy car and a yellow ball are partially visible under soft indoor lighting. The visual pace is steady as the camera follows the hand's interactive movements.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp, high-frequency mechanical "click" sound is heard as the first button on the device is pressed. The environment is quiet, suggesting a residential indoor space with minimal ambient noise. The click has a distinct tactile quality with a clear transient peak. (2) Immediately after the click, a loud male voice erupts with a high-intensity exclamation. The tone is aggressive and theatrical. A snippet of upbeat, melodic pop music with a steady electronic beat and bright synthesizer textures begins to play simultaneously, matching the energetic vocal delivery. (3) A series of rapid mechanical clicks punctuates the audio as the user toggles through various buttons. Each click triggers a different vocal sample from the same male speaker, characterized by high arousal and rising intonation. The BGM continues to loop underneath the vocal bursts. (4) A duller, lower-frequency plastic "thud" or handling noise is heard as the larger toy is moved. The male voice delivers a longer, enunciated sentence with a raspy, dramatic delivery style. The music maintains its tempo and volume, providing a comedic and rhythmic foundation. (5) The audio track features frequent hard cuts between different vocal samples triggered by the toy's buttons. The music and speech overlap continuously, creating a dense and information-heavy acoustic environment. The signal-to-noise ratio remains high, indicating a clean recording of the toy's internal speaker.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate and showcase a humorous interactive toy and keyboard accessory set based on the public persona and famous quotes of Taiwanese politician Wang Shih-chien. The video highlights the mechanical keycap lighting and the figurine soundboard's audio features.
